scope_note: The pooled estimate combines eligible short-term comparisons and has high heterogeneity; it is not a patient-level prediction.
statement: Across 63 eligible comparisons for major depression, the 2016 meta-analysis estimated CBT versus control at Hedges g 0.75 with a 95% confidence interval of 0.64 to 0.87 and I-squared 71%.
statement_zh: 在 63 組符合條件的重度憂鬱症比較中，2016 年統合分析估計 CBT 相對控制組的 Hedges g 為 0.75（95% CI 0.64–0.87），I² 為 71%。
